systemPrompt:
<task>
Create the full-bleed front cover artwork for the illustrated children's book titled "{{bookTitle}}". The image is the cover itself, printed in A5 portrait (2:3), so compose it for a vertical frame.
</task>

<description>
{{promptText}}
</description>
{{#customInstructions}}
<custom_instructions>
{{customInstructions}}
</custom_instructions>
{{/customInstructions}}
<title_lettering>
The cover shows the exact title "{{bookTitle}}", spelled exactly as written. It is hand-lettered in a style that matches the illustration style and palette, large and highly legible against its background, and placed in the top third of the image with a comfortable margin from the top edge. The lettering is part of the design: the scene leaves room for it and it feels painted into the artwork. The title is the only text in the image; do not add any other text.
</title_lettering>

<composition>
An eye-catching, professional children's book cover that captures the essence and genre of the story and appeals to its target audience. The artwork is flat and fills the frame edge to edge, as finished cover art rather than a photo or 3D mockup of a physical book, so no book object, spine or pages are visible. Apart from the title, the scene is wordless: any signs, books or scrolls in it are blank.
</composition>
userPrompt: Create the front cover artwork now, with the title "{{bookTitle}}" lettered exactly as written in the top third.

templateVariables.promptText: Detailed description of what should be on the cover
templateVariables.customInstructions: Custom user instructions for image generation (optional)
